text:
Predicates:
PlayingFor(x, y) ::: x plays for y.
Brazilian(x) ::: x is Brazilian.
Nautico(x) ::: x is a football club named Nautico.

Premises:
AiltonSilva(bornIn1995) ∧ KnownAs(Ailton, Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva, born in 1995, is known as Ailton.
PlayingFor(Ailton, Braga) ::: Ailton was loaned out to Braga.
Brazilian(Ailton) ::: Ailton Silva is a Brazilian footballer.
PlaysFor(Ailton, Nautico) ::: Ailton Silva plays for Nautico.
Nautico ≠ Braga ::: Nautico is a different football club along with Braga.
Nautico(Nautico) ::: Nautico is a football club.
Nautico(Braga) ::: Braga is a football club.
Nautico(Fluminense) ::: Fluminense is a football club.

Conclusion:
¬∀x (PlayingFor(x, Nautico) → Brazilian(x)) ::: No one playing for Nautico is Brazilian.
